data.name: Venipuncture / Blood Sample Collection

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Blood Draw
data.description: Collection of venous blood samples for laboratory analysis including hematology, clinical chemistry, lipid panel, HbA1c, pharmacokinetics, anti-drug antibodies, and other biomarkers

data.name: Urinalysis

code.decode: Urinalysis, by dip stick or tablet reagent for bilirubin, glucose, hemoglobin, ketones, leukocytes, nitrite, pH, protein, specific gravity, urobilinogen, any number of these constituents

data.label: Urine Sample Collection
data.description: Collection of urine samples for urinalysis and urinary albumin creatinine ratio (UACR) testing

data.name: Urine Pregnancy Test

code.decode: Urine pregnancy test, by visual color comparison methods

data.label: UPT
data.description: Local urine pregnancy test performed for individuals of childbearing potential (IOCBP) at specified visits; results must be available before first administration of study intervention

data.name: Serum Pregnancy Test

code.decode: Gonadotropin, chorionic (hCG); quantitative

data.label: Serum Pregnancy Test
data.description: Serum pregnancy test performed by central laboratory for individuals of childbearing potential (IOCBP) at screening; a second negative serum test required if initial test performed more than 30 days before first dose

data.name: 12-Lead Electrocardiogram

code.decode: Electrocardiogram, routine ECG with at least 12 leads; with interpretation and report

data.label: ECG
data.description: Central 12-lead ECG collected before blood sample collection for laboratory testing; performed at screening, randomization, and selected maintenance visits

data.name: DXA Scan

code.decode: Dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA), bone density study, 1 or more sites

data.label: Dual-Energy X-Ray Absorptiometry
data.description: Dual-energy x-ray absorptiometry scan for body composition assessment; participants unable to undergo DXA due to physical limitations of the machine or implants/hardware are not excluded

data.name: Fundus Photography

code.decode: Fundus photography with interpretation and report

data.label: Fundus Photography
data.description: Fundus photography for diabetic retinopathy screening and evaluation; performed at screening for all participants; repeated every 6 months for participants with retinopathy at baseline and annually for those without retinopathy at baseline; evaluated by a qualified eye care professional

data.name: Ophthalmological Assessment

code.decode: Ophthalmological services: medical examination and evaluation with initiation of diagnostic and treatment program; comprehensive, new patient

data.label: Further Ophthalmological Assessment
data.description: Further ophthalmological assessment performed as applicable in addition to fundus photography for diabetic retinopathy evaluation per Section 8.2.11

data.name: Physical Examination

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit for the evaluation and management of an established patient

data.label: Physical Exam
data.description: Complete physical examination required at Visit 1 and Visit 19 (or early discontinuation); symptom-directed physical assessment may be conducted at other visits at investigator discretion

data.name: Vital Signs Measurement

code.decode: Vital signs monitoring including blood pressure and pulse rate

data.label: Vital Signs
data.description: Collection of 3 measures of sitting vital signs including blood pressure and pulse rate; performed before ECG and before blood sample collection for laboratory testing

data.name: Height Measurement

code.decode: Body mass index (BMI), documented

data.label: Height
data.description: Measurement of participant height per instructions in Section 10.7; collected at screening

data.name: Weight Measurement

code.decode: Body mass index (BMI), documented

data.label: Body Weight
data.description: Measurement of participant body weight in fasting state per instructions in Section 10.7; collected at multiple visits throughout the study

data.name: Waist Circumference Measurement

code.decode: Body mass index (BMI), documented

data.label: Waist Circumference
data.description: Measurement of waist circumference per instructions in Section 10.7; collected at randomization and multiple subsequent visits

data.name: Self-Monitoring of Blood Glucose

code.decode: Glucose, blood by glucose monitoring device(s) cleared by the FDA specifically for home use

data.label: SMBG
data.description: Self-monitoring of blood glucose using a BG meter; participants required to collect two 7-point SMBGs on non-consecutive days within 2 weeks prior to the next visit; a 7-point SMBG consists of measurements before and 2 hours after each of 3 main meals within the same day and at bedtime; hypoglycemic events also recorded

data.name: Continuous Blood Glucose Monitoring

code.decode: Ambulatory continuous glucose monitoring of interstitial tissue fluid via a subcutaneous sensor for a minimum of 72 hours; sensor placement, hook-up, calibration of monitor, patient training, removal of sensor, and printout of recording

data.label: CGM
data.description: Continuous blood glucose monitoring performed as part of a CGM substudy (Appendix 9); separate CGM substudy schedule of activities applies

data.name: Hematology Laboratory Testing

code.decode: Blood count; complete (CBC), automated (Hgb, Hct, RBC, WBC and platelet count) and automated differential WBC count

data.label: Hematology
data.description: Blood sample collection and analysis for hematology panel at specified visits

data.name: Hemoglobin A1c Testing

code.decode: Hemoglobin; glycosylated (A1C)

data.label: HbA1c
data.description: Blood sample collection and analysis for hemoglobin A1c at specified visits

data.name: Clinical Chemistry Laboratory Testing

code.decode: Comprehensive metabolic panel

data.label: Clinical Chemistry
data.description: Blood sample collection and analysis for clinical chemistry panel including liver function tests, renal function, and other metabolic markers at specified visits

data.name: Lipid Panel Testing

code.decode: Lipid panel

data.label: Lipid Panel
data.description: Blood sample collection and analysis for lipid panel including apolipoprotein B (ApoB) and apolipoprotein C3 (ApoC3) at specified visits

data.name: Pharmacokinetic Sample Collection

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture for pharmacokinetic analysis

data.label: PK Sample Collection
data.description: Blood sample collection for pharmacokinetic analysis at designated PK-only visits; the only procedure performed at PK-only visits

data.name: Anti-Drug Antibody Testing

code.decode: Unlisted antibody procedure

data.label: ADA Testing
data.description: Blood sample collection and analysis for anti-drug antibodies at specified visits

data.name: Subcutaneous Injection of Study Intervention

code.decode: Therapeutic, prophylactic, or diagnostic injection; subcutaneous or intramuscular

data.label: SC Injection
data.description: Self-administered subcutaneous injection of study intervention by participant; first injection observed by site personnel; weekly injections recorded in electronic diary

data.name: Suicidal Ideation and Behavior Risk Monitoring

code.decode: Brief emotional/behavioral assessment

data.label: C-SSRS Assessment
data.description: Assessment of suicidal ideation and behavior using the Columbia-Suicide Severity Rating Scale (C-SSRS); Screening/Baseline Category Version at Visit 1; Since Last Assessed Clinical Categories Version at subsequent visits; adverse events collected before C-SSRS

data.name: Depression Monitoring

code.decode: Brief emotional/behavioral assessment using standardized instrument

data.label: PHQ-9 Assessment
data.description: Assessment of depression using the Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9) at specified visits; adverse events collected before PHQ-9 collection per Sections 8.2.7 and 8.2.7.1

data.name: Fatigue Assessment Scale

code.decode: Brief emotional/behavioral assessment using standardized instrument

data.label: Fatigue Assessment
data.description: Assessment of fatigue using a standardized fatigue assessment scale per Section 8.2.8

data.name: Patient-Reported Outcome Assessments

code.decode: Administration of patient-focused health risk assessment instrument with scoring and documentation

data.label: PRO Assessments
data.description: Electronic patient-reported outcome assessments including SF-36v2 (Short Form 36 Version 2 Health Survey, Acute Form), IWQOL-Lite-CT (Impact of Weight on Quality of Life-Lite Clinical Trials Version), EQ-5D-5L, PGIS Physical Function Weight, CoEQ (Control of Eating Questionnaire), and FNQ (Food Noise Questionnaire)

data.name: Hepatic Safety Monitoring

code.decode: Hepatic function panel

data.label: Liver Chemistry Monitoring
data.description: Hepatic safety monitoring including evaluation of liver chemistry tests; criteria for study drug interruption or discontinuation per Section 8.2.9; suggested actions and follow-up assessments per Appendix 6

data.name: Diabetic Retinopathy Screening and Evaluation

code.decode: Dilated macular or fundus exam performed, including documentation of the presence or absence of macular edema and level of diabetic retinopathy

data.label: Retinopathy Screening
data.description: Screening and evaluation for diabetic retinopathy per Section 8.2.11; includes fundus photography evaluated by a qualified eye care professional; baseline fundus photography must be evaluated prior to randomization

data.name: Lifestyle Counseling

code.decode: Medical nutrition therapy; initial assessment and intervention, individual, face-to-face with the patient, each 15 minutes

data.label: Lifestyle Counseling
data.description: Lifestyle counseling provided at randomization and maintenance visits; may occur on a separate day from other visit procedures; may be delivered by telehealth; includes nutrition and physical activity guidance per Sections 5.3, 5.3.1, and 5.3.2

data.name: Injection Training

code.decode: Educational supplies, e.g., books, tapes, provided by the physician for the patient's education at cost to physician

data.label: Injection Training
data.description: Training of participants on self-administration of subcutaneous study intervention injection at randomization visit; repeated as needed

data.name: Diabetes Education and SMBG Training

code.decode: Education and training for patient self-management by a qualified, nonphysician health care professional

data.label: Diabetes Education
data.description: Diabetes education including blood glucose meter dispensing and self-monitoring blood glucose (SMBG) training at Visit 2

data.name: Genetics Sample Collection

code.decode: Unlisted molecular pathology procedure

data.label: Genetics
data.description: Genetic sample collection per Appendix 5

data.name: High Sensitivity C-Reactive Protein Testing

code.decode: C-reactive protein; high sensitivity (hsCRP)

data.label: hsCRP
data.description: Blood sample collection and analysis for high sensitivity C-reactive protein (hsCRP) at specified visits

data.name: Thyroid Stimulating Hormone Testing

code.decode: Thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH)

data.label: TSH
data.description: Blood sample collection and analysis for thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH) at specified visits

data.name: Follicle Stimulating Hormone Testing

code.decode: Gonadotropin; follicle stimulating hormone (FSH)

data.label: FSH
data.description: Blood sample collection and analysis for follicle stimulating hormone (FSH) at specified visits

data.name: eGFR Assessment

code.decode: Glomerular filtration rate/1.73 sq M.predicted

data.label: eGFR
data.description: Estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) calculated using the CKD Epidemiology Collaboration (CKD-EPI) equation from clinical chemistry results

data.name: Electronic Diary Device
data.label: Electronic Diary
data.description: Electronic diary device provided to participants for recording hypoglycemic events, 7-point SMBG values, and weekly study medication injections; returned by participant at last visit

data.name: Blood Glucose Meter
data.label: BG Meter
data.description: Blood glucose meter dispensed to participants for self-monitoring of blood glucose (SMBG); used for 7-point SMBG measurements and hypoglycemia monitoring; dispensed with supplies as needed throughout the study

data.name: Continuous Glucose Monitor
data.label: CGM
data.description: Continuous glucose monitoring device used in the CGM substudy (Appendix 9) for interstitial tissue fluid glucose monitoring

data.name: DXA Machine
data.label: DXA Scanner
data.description: Dual-energy x-ray absorptiometry machine used for body composition scanning; participants with implants, hardware, or other foreign materials that may interfere with the scan per manufacturer specifications may be unable to undergo the procedure

data.name: 12-Lead ECG Device
data.label: ECG Machine
data.description: Central 12-lead electrocardiogram device used for cardiac monitoring at specified visits

data.name: Fundus Camera
data.label: Fundus Camera
data.description: Fundus photography equipment used for diabetic retinopathy screening and evaluation; photographs evaluated by a qualified eye care professional

data.name: Autoinjector / Injection Device
data.label: Study Intervention Injection Device
data.description: Injection device used by participants for weekly self-administration of subcutaneous study intervention; ancillary supplies dispensed as needed; first injection observed by site personnel

data.name: Interactive Web Response System
data.label: IWRS
data.description: Interactive web response system used for participant registration, randomization to treatment, and dispensing of study intervention at each visit

data.name: Genetics Specimens
data.description: Genetic sample collection is referenced in Appendix 5 (Genetics), indicating specimens are collected and retained for genetic analysis. The protocol references genetics as a separate appendix topic, implying retention of genetic/DNA-containing specimens.
